description: Edit a member's nickname or voice state. Voice changes (server mute, server deafen, move to another voice channel) only apply while the member is connected to voice. Role changes go through assign_role and remove_role.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

move_to_voice.description: Voice channel name or ID to move the member into.

nickname.description: New nickname, or empty string to clear it.
